[[Mantid Drone Hatchling]]s appear in the Monastery Overlook along with one [[Mantid Hatchling]] as part of your tutorial and the [[Mantid Hatchlings]] quest. They are a bit tougher than the Mantid Hatchling, but are still quite easy to defeat. They are also encountered in Saoshang Trail. They appear alone but as your party approaches, other Mantis will appear around the hatchling.
